title: SETAREH Transform: A Sorting-Assisted Haar-Wavelet Sparsification Method for Approximate Inner-Product Computation
abstract: arXiv:2610.23338v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern deep learning systems increasingly rely on high-dimensional vector operations, in which large input and parameter vectors are repeatedly stored, transferred, and processed. Although substantial research has focused on reducing neural-network model size through pruning, quantization, knowledge distillation, and efficient architectures, the storage, memory-traffic, and communication costs associated with repeatedly presented high-dimensional input vectors remain important practical considerations, particularly in distributed and edge-computing environments. This paper proposes the SETAREH (Sorting-assisted Energy-concentrating Transform for Approximate Representation using Haar wavelets) transform, a Haar-wavelet-based sparsification approach for approximating the inner product between a fixed high-dimensional coefficient vector and successive input vectors. translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.23338v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：现代深度学习系统日益依赖高维向量运算，其中大型输入向量与参数向量需要被反复存储、传输和处理。尽管已有大量研究致力于通过剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏和高效架构来压缩神经网络模型规模，但与反复出现的高维输入向量相关的存储、内存流量和通信成本仍是重要的实际问题，在分布式和边缘计算环境中尤其如此。本文提出了SETAREH（基于Haar小波的排序辅助能量集中近似表示变换）变换，这是一种基于Haar小波的稀疏化方法，用于近似固定高维系数向量与连续输入向量之间的内积。通过对两者施加相同的排列序列和Haar变换（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出SETAREH变换，一种利用排序辅助实现能量集中的Haar小波稀疏化方法，可高效近似固定高维系数向量与连续输入向量之间的内积，从而显著降低高维向量运算中的存储、内存流量与通信开销。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the SETAREH transform, a sorting-assisted Haar-wavelet sparsification method that concentrates energy to efficiently approximate inner products between a fixed high-dimensional coefficient vector and successive input vectors, thereby reducing storage, memory-traffic, and communication costs in distributed and edge-computing environments.
